title: DruidManaBar
wikitext: Displays a mana bar when shapeshifted. == How to Install == # Visit the GitHub link you find, then click the green '''<> Code''' button, and select Download ZIP. # Use [https://www.7-zip.org/ 7zip] to extract the zip # Move the DruidManaBar folder into your AddOns folder # Restart the game '''Optional:''' [https://github.com/balakethelock/SuperWoW SuperWoW] == Git Links == * [https://github.com/gashole/DruidManaBar '''(gashole)'''] * [https://github.com/kluy18/DruidManaBar '''(kluy18)'''] == Preview == [[File:Dmb0.png|frameless|280x280px]] [[Category:Addon]]
